material.label: Reference cold-formed galvanized steel — Metsec Metframe

coreThicknessRule.note: ArcelorMittal Orange Book states 0.02 mm coating per face for standard Z275 and references EN 1993-1-3 for core thickness.

prototypeLayers.scope: Logical parts schedule for the layered physical prototype; no price, fixings, stock optimization or machine release.

studSpacingMm.condition: Illustrated SFS wall build-ups; final centres must be determined by project-specific design.

doorNominalWidthMm.condition: Applicability depends on building type, door function and current project regulation.

hautsDeFranceSteelBudgetPrice.method: Arithmetic mean of 3.32 €/kg (French cold-formed Z275 construction database), 1.00 €/m ÷ 0.55 kg/m = 1.82 €/kg (regional Lille M48 retail cross-check), and 9.96 € ÷ 2.419 kg = 4.12 €/kg (M100 retail cross-check), rounded to 3.09 €/kg ex VAT.
hautsDeFranceSteelBudgetPrice.boundary: Material supply only, ex VAT. Excludes delivery, minimum-order effects, fasteners, fabrication, waste, labour and installation.
hautsDeFranceSteelBudgetPrice.limitation: No public statistical average was found for the exact Metframe profiles in Hauts-de-France. This is a transparent regional budget proxy using one local listing and two comparable French references.

memberMassKg.verification: Sum by member is cross-checked against BOM grouped length × mass per metre.

densityCrossCheckKgPerM.limitation: Flat-width approximation excludes bend radii and detailed coating geometry; used only as an independent plausibility check.

steelMemberDevelopedAreaApproxM2.verification: Calculated independently for every steel member and exported in the cutting list.
steelMemberDevelopedAreaApproxM2.limitation: Flat developed-area approximation; bend radii and detailed coating geometry are excluded.

prototypeInsulationCavityParts.formula: wall X/Z domain minus the projected union of every generated steel-member envelope and every door/window opening; adjacent free atomic cells with equal X span are merged vertically
prototypeInsulationCavityParts.verification: Every output rectangle is checked for zero positive-area overlap with steel envelopes and openings; merged area is reconciled with the part sum.
prototypeInsulationCavityParts.limitation: Logical rectangular prototype pieces only; compression allowance, joints, installation clearance and cutting waste are not added.

prototypePanelNetAreaM2.verification: Each non-insulation layer carries one logical wall contour and the same number of cutouts as the source wall openings.
prototypePanelNetAreaM2.limitation: One logical prototype contour; commercial stock-sheet subdivision, joints, fasteners and waste are not optimized.

prototypePartVolumeM3.verification: Layer totals equal the sum of their individual part volumes.
prototypePartVolumeM3.limitation: Reference-product quantity only; no price or procurement claim.

assemblyPriorityOrder.formula: sort actual generated members by FRAMECAD wall-type role priority; for multiple openings, process openings by increasing x coordinate; skip member types absent from the generated model; renumber every remaining member continuously from 1
assemblyPriorityOrder.verification: Orders must be continuous from 1 to component count, unique, complete, and identical in the Fabrication table, cutting list, machine-neutral CSV, labels CSV and manufacturing handover JSON.
assemblyPriorityOrder.limitation: Deterministic reference loading/assembly order only. The project does not generate RFY, machine paths, cycle times or an Avelis-approved production sequence.

materialCostEur.verification: Program reproduces all three normalized source prices and their arithmetic mean.

stepProfileEnvelopeGeometry.formula: one closed six-face MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP box per generated member bounds[min,max]
stepProfileEnvelopeGeometry.verification: Generated ISO 10303-21 output is re-imported with Open CASCADE; mesh count, positive geometry and overall bounding box are compared with the candidate model.
stepProfileEnvelopeGeometry.limitation: Coordination envelope only; not the detailed C/U sheet-metal section, holes, fasteners, tolerances or machine path.
